shots.detail_en: CH's mop stops one inch from a silver serving tray that blocks his path, two teacups steaming on it in the hall corner.
shots.fx: porcelain clink + mop water cut dead

shots.detail_en: WAITER bows slightly in black vest and white gloves, presenting a gilded new name card with both hands, its engraved name catching the screen's red glow.
shots.sub: 侍者："熊先生，请陆先生上楼喝茶。"
shots.speaker: 侍者
shots.fx: card stock friction + hall noise dipping

shots.detail_en: CH glances once at the card, shifts the mop to his other hand, eyelids never lifting.
shots.sub: 长虹："我扫地的，楼上不归我扫。"
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: WAITER lowers his hands, posture impeccable yet the tray still fences the only path, his words pressing forward.
shots.sub: 侍者："这杯茶，不喝也得上楼。"
shots.speaker: 侍者

shots.detail_en: XTC's VIP tea room: purple-clay pot, white porcelain cups, a clay stove at near boil, the hall's red glow bleeding through the glass onto the tea tray.
XTC scalds the cups himself and pours with an unwavering waterline, beads flat against his wrist, eyes rising to signal the empty seat opposite.
shots.sub: 熊天成："坐。楼下的尘，上不来。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成
shots.fx: pouring stream + tea landing in porcelain

shots.detail_en: CH stands before the tea table without sitting, mop still in hand, collar immaculate.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: XTC's gaze rises from the tea to CH's eyes and holds there, the smile never reaching its own depth.
shots.sub: 熊天成："你的眼神，像一位故人。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH lifts the cup, blows the foam aside, sips once, sets it down, every motion sealed tight, eyes level as the flattest stretch of a chart.
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: breath over tea + one cup landing

shots.detail_en: XTC's smiling face wavers on the tea's surface, the laugh lines kneaded by the ripples.
shots.sub: 熊天成："半年，就能三点位全中？"
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH pushes his cup half an inch forward, the base grinding one soft note out of the table.
shots.sub: 长虹："蒙的。蒙错了——您连名字都不会问。"
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: cup grinding on table + one-beat rest

shots.detail_en: XTC slides a gilded VIP plaque engraved 'Lianhua VIP' across the table with two fingers, gliding toward CH's hand.
shots.fx: gold plaque dull slide on wood

shots.detail_en: CH's face is lit by the plaque's golden glare as it stops at his hand, the light swimming across unmoving pupils.
CH pushes the plaque back along its exact path with two fingers, pressure calibrated to the ounce.
shots.sub: 长虹："我一楼看得清楚。人多的地方，地才脏。"
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CROWD surges beyond the landing glass below, a tide of heads swelling before the bell, their roar muffled to a low hum through the glass.
XTC retrieves the plaque and brushes his cuff, voice warm as a sermon while his gaze rides the tide beyond the glass.
shots.sub: 熊天成："市场惩罚的是贪婪的人——我，只是市场的一只手。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH hoists his mop and turns for the stairway, white shirt stark against the VIP room's dark gold, XTC's mouth opening behind his back.
CH's back stalls half a step at the stairway without turning, while deep in the room XTC lifts his own cup as a silhouette.
shots.sub: 熊天成（画外）："我从来没有做错过任何事——所以这一次，我只想看看，你会怎么错。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成（画外）

shots.detail_en: CH reclaims his mop back on the hall floor, the red and green board light alternating across his face column by column.
shots.sub: 旁白（长虹）："这杯茶我喝了——这一局，我没接。"
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: XW's after-hours screen: red rings close one by one around CH's account cluster, the cursor pausing, lens glare floating.
shots.sub: 熊伟："拒绝收编的样本，更值得观察。"
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XW drags the ringed cluster into a newly created folder named '观察池', the faintest smile surfacing behind his lens glare.
shots.sub: 熊伟（低）："进池子吧——陆先生。"
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Black end card with white Chinese text fading in.
shots.sub: 有人要捧他上天——有人，在楼下等他。
shots.speaker: 字幕
shots.card: 有人要捧他上天——有人，在楼下等他。
